title: User
description: Represents a user within the Royal Clean Dashboard system with role-based access control.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user (typically matches Firebase Auth UID).

role.description: The role of the user determining their access level.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

phone.description: The phone number of the user (optional).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
